verdict.rationale: Buzz exposes a documented open wire API. Any NIP-29 client can connect directly to buzz-relay with NIP-42 auth, backed by a feature-status table and a quick start. There is also a documented /api/admin/v1 admin API using NIP-98 signed-event auth, discoverable via NIP-11, and the relay serves REST alongside WebSocket. Missing for 10: a machine-readable API spec (the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all returned 404), a documented reference for the general REST surface beyond admin, and independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.
